title: Geometric Borel and parabolic fibres
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $i:P\to G$ a homomorphism of group schemes [def-sc-group-scheme] over $\operatorname{Spec} A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For a map $f:A\to F$ define the fibre functor by pullback along $\operatorname{Spec}f$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Say $i$ has Borel fibres if for every algebraically closed field $F$ and every $f:A\to F$, its pullback is a Borel inclusion [def-sfb-borel-subgroup-scheme]. Say $i$ has parabolic fibres if each such $P_F$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] and connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] and there is a Borel inclusion $b:B\to G_F$ factoring as $B\to P_F\to G_F$. Relative smoothness and closedness of $i$ are imposed separately when needed.
